WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as group_count
  FROM riskandmargin r 
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault 
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_count) as avg_count FROM matched
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT m.group_count, oa.avg_count
  FROM matched m
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE m.group_count > oa.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(group_count) as avg_of_kept_counts,
  AVG(group_count - avg_count) as avg_deviation
FROM filtered
